selection.population: All 95 cells in the new-generation matrix (Rounds 2-9) that NO blind rater has ever seen. Enumerated mechanically from patterns-matrix.md minus the 47 cells rated in rounds 1-4, not chosen by recall.
selection.rule: Declared before running: (1) stratify by incumbent score; (2) within each stratum sort promoted-pattern cells first, then alphabetically by pattern@repo; (3) cap any one pattern at 2 cells across the whole round so coverage spreads; (4) take 5/3/5/5 from strata 0/1/2/3. Stratum 1 holds only 3 cells, so all three are taken.
selection.why_stratified: Round 1 selected only load-bearing cells, which meant only cells already scored 2-3: incumbent sd 0.34, and ICC collapsed to 0.143 despite 80% exact agreement (anti-pattern 24). Round 4's population had almost no variance at all, so ICC was correctly refused there. THIS sample is built to have range: incumbent sd 1.199, 18 items evenly spread across all four scores. ICC is legitimate here for the first time in a stratified round, and that is the reason it is used.

scale: 0 absent - no evidence in the repo at HEAD. 1 weak - a faint trace; one occurrence; not load-bearing. 2 moderate - multiple occurrences; load-bearing; visible to a reader skimming the repo. 3 strong - a defining feature of the repo's identity at HEAD. Taken unchanged from patterns-matrix.md, so the scale is not a variable. Score from the repo AT HEAD, not from PR bodies or anything you have read about it (anti-pattern 27).
incumbent: the existing matrix score, assigned by one model in one session

statistics.primary: ICC(2,1) two-way random, absolute agreement, single measure - across the three raters, and again with the incumbent added
secondary: exact-match with the incumbent, per stratum
reason-correctness, scored separately against the repos (rounds 8-9 found scores and reasons dissociate: 24/24 vs 14/24)
statistics.adoption_rule: A cell changes only where all three raters move in the same direction relative to the incumbent; the new score is their median. Same rule as rounds 2-3, kept unchanged for comparability.

preregistered_prediction.claim: The incumbent's POLARISING BIAS reproduces a third time, on a third disjoint item set: mean(rater - incumbent) > 0 on the incumbent-0/1 items AND < 0 on the incumbent-2/3 items.
preregistered_prediction.direction_only: Magnitude is not predicted, only the two signs. If either sign comes back the other way, the bias is not a stable property of the incumbent and the two prior measurements were selection artefacts.
preregistered_prediction.what_would_refute_it: mean(rater - incumbent) <= 0 on the low stratum, or >= 0 on the high stratum.

blinding.not_attempted_this_round: Three methods have failed: instruction (rounds 1-2), whole-file removal (round 3), paragraph removal (round 9). Anti-pattern 32 says stop attempting it. No removal is tried here.
blinding.instead: The items the injected text touches are named IN ADVANCE (see primed_by_injected_text on items 2, 3, 6, 12, 14) and their agreement is discounted in the report regardless of how it comes out.
blinding.measurement: Mandatory `BLINDING:` first line quoting what was received verbatim.
